reviewScope: All six final framed PNGs inspected visually at phone-listing scale; no renderer or image edits made during review.

frameCheck.uiTransform: Complete raw 1080x1920 UI uniformly scaled to 936x1664 (13/15) at x=72,y=204; no crop or edits inside UI rectangle.
frameCheck.result: All six frames show the app UI without frame-induced clipping, overlap, or external claims beyond the displayed screen content. Titles are legible.

limits: This is a visual and framing review only; it does not establish Google Play acceptance, conversion performance, or device-wide behavior.

The screenshots represent the named preview APK and source commit; later app changes require fresh captures and review.
